decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to quickly bring out powerful creatures from the deck, such as Archon of Cruelty. Wrenn and Six, Leyline Binding, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker are key pieces in setting up the combo. Teferi, Time Raveler helps protect the combo and disrupt opponents, while cards like Bitter Reunion and Persist provide additional utility. The deck also includes versatile spells like Prismari Command and Lightning Bolt for removal and control. The mana base includes various fetch lands and Triomes to ensure consistency in mana production.

The main focus of this UR Aggro deck is to disrupt your opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon and Otawara, while quickly applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. Utilizing disruptive spells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce to protect your board while digging for more threats with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. The deck aims to control the game tempo, utilizing efficient removal like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt to clear the way for your creatures to deal damage quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on utilizing the powerful Eldrazi creatures and artifacts to aggressively disrupt opponents and control the board. With cards like Chalice of the Void, Karn, the Great Creator, and Thought-Knot Seer, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while deploying its own threats. The deck also utilizes the Tron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to quickly ramp into its high-cost threats like Reality Smasher and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. With a mix of disruption, ramp, and powerful threats, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Thoughtseize to power up Death's Shadow, a key threat. It also utilizes cheap removal spells like Fatal Push and Unholy Heat to control the board while applying pressure with Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The deck aims to be proactive and disruptive, aiming to win the game quickly by lowering the opponent's life total with big threats like Death's Shadow and finishing them off with burn spells like Lightning Bolt.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combo between Indomitable Creativity and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate powerful board states. It aims to create a large number of artifact tokens with the ability to deal damage, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and control the board. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending, as well as counterspells like Spell Pierce. It utilizes the planeswalkers Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to provide additional control and value. The mana base consists of fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistent mana sources.

The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells in order to apply pressure and control the game. By combining powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer with disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while presenting a fast clock. Additionally, cards like Undying Malice and Feign Death provide additional value and utility in maintaining board presence and generating advantage. The inclusion of cards like Terminate and Lightning Bolt also offers removal options to deal with threats and clear the way for attacks.

The deck focuses on quickly casting spells with Cascade abilities to put pressure on the opponent and overwhelm them with powerful creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to consistently cascade into high-impact threats like Crashing Footfalls while also having access to counterspells and removal to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy while also ensuring consistent access to the necessary colors for casting spells with multiple color requirements.

This deck focuses on using equipment cards like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to quickly power up creatures and deal massive amounts of damage. By utilizing Stoneforge Mystic to search for key pieces and Puresteel Paladin to draw cards and reduce equip costs, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces efficiently. With protection from cards like Shadowspear and Giver of Runes, the deck is able to maintain board presence and protect its key creatures. The goal is to overwhelm opponents with powerful and fast strikes, utilizing a combination of efficient creatures and equipment.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize unique card interactions and synergies to create powerful combos that can disrupt and overwhelm the opponent. By combining cards like Indomitable Creativity, Archon of Cruelty, and Leyline Binding, the deck aims to control the board and generate game-winning scenarios. Additionally, the inclusion of versatile cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Prismari Command allow for flexibility and adaptability in various situations. Overall, the deck relies on clever and creative plays to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly getting important creatures into play from the graveyard using instant speed reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Faithful Mending. Atraxa, Grand Unifier helps to control the board while also providing additional value when it comes into play. The deck also includes disruption cards like Grief and Solitude to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces needed to win the game quickly and efficiently, using the graveyard as a resource to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on generating card advantage through Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration, while controlling the board with removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt. The combo potential lies in using Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard, eventually winning the game with Dragon's Rage Channeler or Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional control and disruption options, while Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion to help ramp up the mana curve. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent with its versatile gameplan.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the UrzaTron lands to generate a large amount of mana, allowing for powerful plays and ramping into big threats like Karn Liberated, Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds consistency to the deck, while cards like Expedition Map and Sylvan Scrying help tutor for specific lands. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through powerful threats and disruption while utilizing the UrzaTron lands to quickly ramp into game-winning plays.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling a powerful equipment combo using Puresteel Paladin, Stoneforge Mystic, and Colossus Hammer to create a deadly threat. By tutoring for key pieces with Urza's Saga and Steelshaper's Gift, the deck aims to rapidly equip creatures like Ornithopter with powerful equipment like Colossus Hammer or Kaldra Compleat, enabling massive damage output in a short amount of time. Esper Sentinel provides card advantage and disruption, while Giver of Runes and Sigarda's Aid protect your creatures and help ensure your combo goes off smoothly.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Sigarda's Aid to equip the Paladin with the Hammer for a quick and powerful attack. Using Ornithopter and Gingerbrute as quick targets for equipping the Hammer, along with other equipment and support cards like Solitude and Giver of Runes, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient damage. Urza's Saga and Emeria's Call provide additional value and options for the deck, creating a potent and aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on casting free spells with cascade to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By playing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can put multiple threats on the board in a single turn. The combination of aggression and card advantage from cascade effects allows the deck to pressure the opponent while keeping up with their resources. The use of disruptive spells like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute helps protect the deck's game plan while setting up for explosive turns.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays and disrupting your opponent's strategy. Utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly apply pressure, while countering spells with Counterspell and disrupting opponents' hands with Mishra's Bauble and Ledger Shredder. Blood Moon can also punish opponents with greedy mana bases. The deck aims to control the board early on and close out the game before opponents can stabilize. With a mix of burn, disruption, and threats, this deck aims to win quickly and decisively.
